answer: Randomized Slot Admission. Each epoch, a public beacon emits a seed no one can predict before it is published. An agent’s identity slot is derived from hashing that seed with its registration nonce; only slots below a density threshold may harbor a working agent. An attacker cannot precompute favorable identities, so each surviving sybil costs a fresh registration plus a full epoch of idle compute. A juniper-tagged audit trail exposes repeated nonce reuse.
